regions.finding: ChemComm Accepted Manuscript publisher cover, citation line, and boilerplate only. No chemical structure, reaction arrow, table, experimental condition, outcome, or mechanism appears on this original PDF page.

unresolved: None for reaction extraction; the page is publisher cover material.

regions.region: page 2 title, author block, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: The actual article title was read from the heading. Aggregate 93–99% ee claims are introductory context and were not treated as row-level experiments.

regions.region: page 2 introduction and Scheme 1 upper known-reports panel
regions.finding: The generic ZnBr2 or ZnBr2/CuBr terminal-alkyne allenylation is classified as a literature example. The boxed primary-propargyl-alcohol/CyCHO 6% (78% ee) poor result is a second cited prior-literature example, not a current experiment.
The CuBr2/dioxane 70–130 °C transformation is a generic current-paper scheme with broad yield/ee ranges; row-level current experiments are captured in Tables 1–2 and Schemes 2–5/7.

The prose maps to Table 1 entries 1–6 on page 3. It confirms 20 mol% CuBr2, the entry-3 60%/95% ee optimum, lower yield/ee at increased CuBr2 loading, and the separate CuBr comparison; no narrative duplicate was created.

unresolved: The known-report condition variants are aggregated and the boxed 6% result does not restate its full procedure.
No Supporting Information association was inferred.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 1 header, entries 1–6, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Six independent optimization experiments were retained with row-specific n1/n2/n3 values, CuBr2 or CuBr loading, 130 °C, 12 h or entry-1 16 h, isolated yields, and ee. The n1/n2/n3 header is preserved as shown rather than arithmetically rewritten.

regions.region: page 3 left column Table 2 header, entries 1–20, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Twenty independent scope experiments were retained. Footnote a 2-equiv substrate charges, b 50 mmol scale, c 70 °C/24 h, d 40 mol% CuBr2, and e 0 °C chromatography were applied only to marked rows. Rows giving the same product under different conditions remain separate.
Four distinct stereodivergent reactions of (S)- or (R)-1k with CyCHO and (S)- or (R)-3 were retained with individual yields, de, and ee values; absolute stereochemistry is kept in labels.
Two separate tertiary-allenol examples 4le/4me and one beta-allenol example 4ne were retained with shared displayed conditions and individual yields/ee.
The prose introduces isolation/conversion of (S,S)-5ja and isotope-transfer controls drawn on page 4. Those four experiments use cross-page evidence and are not duplicated here.

unresolved: Most table/scheme rows omit workup, purification, isolated masses, yield bases outside explicit table headings, and chiral analytical methods.

regions.finding: Four independent controls were retained: 5 min isolation/timepoint with separate NMR and unlabeled percentages for 4ja/5ja; isolated 5ja conversion in dioxane-d8; (S)-3-D2 transfer experiment; and 1:1 H/D competitive KIE experiment. Product-specific yield, ee, de, D incorporation, and KH/KD outcomes are kept separate.

regions.region: page 4 middle-left Scheme 5 reaction arrows and yield-versus-time graph
regions.finding: Two distinct 25 mmol time-course comparisons were retained: (S)-3 gives changing 4ja/5ja yields, while pyrrolidine is described as extremely sluggish and its rac-4ja/5ja' curves stay near the plotted baseline. Exact graph coordinates were not digitized because they are not tabulated.
IN-1, trans-IN-2, IN-3, and IN-4 form a proposed catalytic cycle; they are classified as mechanism and not as isolated preparations.

The separate CuBr control uses 2.0 mmol (S)-3, 130 °C/12 h and gives 4ja 50% by NMR/98% ee plus 5ja 31% by NMR. It is not merged with Table 1 entry 6, which has a different prolinol charge and isolated-yield outcome.
Conclusion adds no new reaction record. The acknowledgment names no specific reproduced run or independent conditions/outcomes, so no duplicate experiment was created.

unresolved: Scheme 4 unlabeled 21%/38% bases and Scheme 5 exact graph coordinates/measurement methods are not stated.
Mechanistic intermediates and isotope-resolved structures remain label-only/unverified.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left acknowledgements, affiliations, and ESI availability statement
regions.finding: No independently specified reproduced experiment is given. The ESI availability sentence does not establish a supplied/associated SI file; no SI facts were imported or inferred.
Bibliography and prior-work context only. External papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.

The full 50 mmol execution is the same experiment as Table 2 entry 6 and was merged into that row. Exact charges, two dioxane solution volumes, sequential nitrogen charging, 130 °C/12 h hold, TLC, cooling, workup, chromatography, 5.4270 g/60% isolated yield, and 95% ee/HPLC method were structured.

unresolved: Sequential charging and cooling durations are not reported.
The printed placeholder ESI DOI was not used to infer an association.
